Hi again,
You said you've been feeling overwhelmed, scattered, a little too affected by everything around you. Most of the time that doesn't show up in obvious ways. You just feel off.

Rereading an email before you send it, adjusting your tone so it lands right. Walking out of a conversation and realizing you're still in it, even after it's over. Catching yourself holding tension in your jaw halfway through the day, without remembering when it started.

You move through your day the way you always do. You handle things, stay composed, make decisions, respond, adapt. From the outside, nothing looks off. But you're constantly readjusting to keep it that way, and over time, that wears on you.

Not in a dramatic way. Your patience feels a little shorter. Your reactions a little quicker. There's a certain kind of tired that doesn't go away with sleep. It passes, or at least lessens, but it never fully clears.

After a while, it gets hard to tell what's actually draining you. You get so used to managing everything in real time that it starts to feel normal. Normal to hold tension in your body. Normal to push through exhaustion before you've had a chance to feel what you're actually feeling.

You get so used to holding everything that you stop noticing how much it's costing you.

And somewhere along the way, you start to feel disconnected from yourself. Not completely. Just enough to notice you're no longer as grounded, no longer as present.

That's where we’ll start. Coming back to your body, your energy, your own center. Strengthening your connection to what's yours, and getting clearer on everything you've been carrying that isn't.

Some people are affected by everything around them. A crowded room leaves them drained. A hard conversation lingers for hours after it's over. Over time, it gets difficult to tell what's actually yours and what you've picked up from everyone and everything around you.

If that sounds familiar, here's something worth knowing: protection doesn't mean shutting the world out.

Most people think of energetic protection as building walls. Disconnecting. Guarding yourself. But real protection is sovereignty. It's knowing where you end and everything else begins. Staying connected to yourself even when life is loud, demanding, or overwhelming.

The question isn't how to keep the world out. It's how you strengthen your connection to what's actually yours.

That connection isn't built once. It's rebuilt, again and again, especially on the days the world asks the most of you. Having something tangible to return to makes that easier.

This is why I work with crystals the way I do. Each piece is intentionally created and energetically prepared to act as a marker of that line, a physical reminder of where you end and everything else begins. When you're overwhelmed, or pulled in six directions, or carrying something that isn't yours, the piece is there to bring you back to yourself.

Worn consistently, it becomes less about protection from the world and more about staying rooted in who you are inside it.

The more connected you are to yourself, the less you need to keep it out.

We often miss the ways healing is already happening because we’re waiting for something bigger. Sometimes the shift is simply noticing the pattern sooner or responding differently to something that would have consumed you a year ago. Don’t dismiss the ripple because you were expecting a wave.
If you’re noticing something beginning to shift, there are a few ways I can support you. Choose what feels right for where you are.

This year arrives with hooves that shake the earth and breath that fans dormant embers into flame. This is not a year for sitting still. It’s not one for half-truths or playing small either.

In shamanic terms, Horse medicine is about freedom, embodied power and the wild momentum of aligned action. In 2026, the spirit of Horse will ask you: where have you been holding back? Where have you been waiting for permission, for perfect conditions, for someone else to go first?

This will be a year of breaking free from old pastures—the relationships, identities, careers, or spiritual boxes that felt safe but have become confining.

And here's what matters most: Horse energy must be met with intention so you avoid galloping in circles rather than toward your destiny. Before Horse year officially begins on 2/17, you have the opportunity to chart your course and figure out where this wild energy wants to carry you.

Work with these pieces now, during this liminal window, to align yourself with Horse energy.
